title: Add a Preferences page and persist its options
summary: Registers an extension page in the Altium Designer Preferences dialog through the protected ServerModule and OptionsForm contract, and stores its value with ServerOptionsReader/Writer, including Preferences export/import.
phrasings: add my own page to the Preferences dialog
take part in preferences export and import

commands.name: ShowPreference
commands.description: Read [General] Temperature with Utils.ServerOptionsReader (value, ValueExists, default '100'), the value the page has cached, and the shim's counters: RegisterOptionsPages calls, pages created, SetStateControls/GetStateControls/SetDefaultState calls, notifications received (and with code 1023), exports/imports, last save, last error

commands.name: SetPreference
commands.description: Write [General] Temperature with Utils.ServerOptionsWriter (or erase the section), Flush, read it back with a new reader and reload the page's cache

commands.name: ExportPreferencesFolder
commands.description: Report IClientAPI_Interface.SpecialFolder_ExportPreferences; with WriteIni, write MyPref_General.ini there (or in Folder, which must exist) with the data manager's code (the value the page has cached) and read it back
commands.params: WriteIni (flag, optional; writes a file)|Folder=<folder> (optional, default the export folder)
